package.name: gelinder_control
package.description: Locomotion mode nodes for the Gelinder reconfigurable rolling-crawling robot: transform_to_roll (fold all 12 joints into the wheel shape) and roll_forward / roll_left / roll_right / roll_center (continuous wheel spin once folded). Each mode is a standalone node runnable with `ros2 run gelinder_control <node_name>`, so no manual `ros2 action send_goal` / `ros2 topic pub` is needed.
